raw_runs.nvram_initialization: empty; the run created its own isolated PinMAME state directory, so the ROM restored its factory settings before the scenario left the message loop with Escape

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted pulses; every diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is the curator's visual reading of its retained DMD frame, identified by its pixel SHA-256. The exact external directory manifest (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes. Exact external directory manifest nf-single-lamps/manifest.json SHA-256 c081b97d212a75bfa6109594b6f3b75ff0f9e59e9f0aeeec12e3882a39efbc5a.
